message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to buy the latest iPhone (iPhone 17 series, released September 2025) in 2026:

## Official Apple Channels

**Apple Store (Online & Retail)**
- The most direct and reliable source for the latest iPhone models
- Offers Apple Trade In, carrier deals, and flexible payment options
- Full warranty and immediate device replacement services
- Visit: https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-iphone

## Authorized Retailers by Region

**Canada**
- **Jump+** (Apple Premium Partner) - Offers iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro, and accessories with financing options
- https://www.jumpplus.com/pages/view-all-iphone

**Singapore**
- **Shopee** (Apple Authorized Reseller) - Currently the cheapest option at SGD 1,049 for iPhone 16 128GB with 5% Shopee Coins cashback
- **Lazada** (Apple Authorized Reseller) - SGD 1,059 with Lazada Wallet 3% cashback
- **Amazon.sg**, **Challenger**, **Best Denki**, **Courts**, **Harvey Norman**
- https://buywhere.ai/blog/where-to-buy-iphone-16-singapore/

**Egypt**
- **Miami Center** - Lists iPhone 17 models with competitive pricing (iPhone 17 256GB at ~72,225 EGP)
- https://miamicenters.com/best-iphone-to-buy-in-2026/

**Nigeria**
- **MacCenter** - Authorized seller with safe purchasing options for iPhone 17 Pro (ranging ₦1,850,000–₦3,000,000)
- https://www.maccenter.com.ng/iphone-17-pro-price-in-nigeria-where-to-buy-safely-in-2026/

**Nepal**
- **Mudita Computer Store** - Carries iPhone 17 with local availability and offers
- https://mudita.com.np/apple-product/iphone-series/iphone-17.html

## General Retailers & E-commerce

- **Amazon** (various regional sites) - Often in stock with Prime delivery options
- **Major electronics chains** like Best Buy, carrier stores, and department stores

## Buying Tips

- Look for **"Apple Authorized Reseller"** badges when buying from third-party platforms
- Authorized resellers typically offer **lower prices** than Apple directly while providing the **same Apple warranty**
- Consider **trade-in programs** and **carrier bill credit deals** for additional savings
- Prices typically drop 8-15% during major sales events (11.11, 12.12, Black Friday)
